review_evidence: src/Sequents/Sequents.thy: typedecl o and seq', consts SeqO'/Seq1', 8 type_synonyms (single_seqe .. four_seqe, sequence_name), sequence parse/print ML.

src/Sequents/LK0.thy: class term, consts True/False/equal/Not/conj/disj/imp/iff/The/All/Ex, axiomatization of LK structural, propositional, quantifier, equality, reflection and description rules, definition If, about 35 lemmas (contR, thinL, iffR, the_equality, mp_R, R_of_imp, sym, trans, if_P, if_not_P).
src/Sequents/LK.thy: axiomatization monotonic and left_cong; lemmas conj_simps, disj_simps, quant_simps, ex_simps, all_simps, de_Morgan_disj, imp_cong, conj_cong, split_if, if_cancel.

src/Sequents/ILL.thy: intuitionistic linear logic consts (tens, limp, FShriek, lconj, ldisj), definitions liff and aneg, axiomatization of about 30 ILL rules, named lemmas aux_impl, conj_lemma, ll_mp, mp_rule1, or_to_and, a_not_a, plus 4 Troelstra-van Dalen examples.
src/Sequents/ILL_predlog.thy: typedecl plf, const PL, translations, 34 named lemmas k49a..k62a from Kleene 1952.
src/Sequents/Modal0.thy: consts box, dia, Lstar, Rstar; definitions strimp and streqv; lemmas iffR, iffL; lemma collections safe_rls, unsafe_rls, bound_rls.

src/Sequents/T.thy, S4.thy, S43.thy: axiomatizations of star-operation Horn clauses and box/diamond rules (S43 adds const S43pi and pi1/pi2 rules); about 20, 37 and 77 modal-logic lemmas respectively (Hughes-Cresswell, Hailpern).
src/Sequents/Washing.thy: axiomatization of 7 constants and rules change/load1/load2/wash/dry in ILL, 3 proved lemmas.
src/Sequents/LK/Nat.thy: typedecl nat, axiomatization Zero/Suc/rec with induct, Suc_inject, rec_0, rec_Suc; definition add; lemmas Suc_n_not_n, add_0, add_Suc, add_assoc, add_0_right, add_Suc_right.
src/Sequents/LK/Propositional.thy: 36 propositional lemmas including Pelletier problems 1-17.
src/Sequents/LK/Quantifiers.thy: about 26 quantifier lemmas and schematic_goals, including Principia Mathematica *11.53/*11.55/*11.61.
src/Sequents/LK/Hard_Quantifiers.thy: about 50 lemmas from Pelletier problems 18-62.
